docker.detail: Local npm run docker:smoke passed after a temporary Docker Desktop launch: compose validation, image build, and a real containerized Playwright Chromium launch. No Hydra containers or hydra_default network remained; docker desktop stop removed the remaining Docker Desktop helper processes.

manual.label: Packaged GUI launch
manual.detail: Open the packaged app with npm run electron:open:mac-arm64 or Finder and confirm Hydra appears as a running app.

manual.label: Window controls
manual.detail: Verify traffic lights, close/minimize/zoom, titlebar drag, tray reopen, and quit behavior.

manual.label: Splash/unlock/dashboard
manual.detail: Verify splash, vault unlock or first-run setup, and Dashboard landing with no blank window.

manual.label: Navigation/dead buttons
manual.detail: Visit Dashboard, Vault, Pool, Traffic, Codes, Generator, Settings, Account Detail, and confirm visible actions give feedback.

manual.label: Touch ID
manual.detail: On Touch ID hardware, enable, test, disable, and unlock with biometric gating.

manual.label: Live account flows
manual.detail: Run at least one live OTP login, bulk OTP isolation pass, code redemption, and proxy/SSE request with real keys.

manual.label: Screenshots
manual.detail: Only after functional dogfood, capture packaged Electron screenshots with secrets redacted.

manual.label: Windows launch
manual.detail: Install and launch the current Windows NSIS artifact on a real Windows desktop; record OS version and install/open result.

notes: This artifact is intentionally redacted. It records checklist status only, not API keys, cookies, account emails, Clerk session IDs, screenshots, or local database contents.
A checked manual item means the operator explicitly passed --manual=<id> after doing that packaged-app step.
